properties.project_name: P10 -- landscaped center island, Mission Bay Circle roundabout
properties.digitized_from: Hand-traced from satellite imagery (contextily/Esri World Imagery), guided directly by the owner's own marked-up screenshot (their drawn outline extracted from the photo via ORB feature-matching/homography rather than re-estimated by eye) -- same technique used for P11/P11A.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19: corrects this tracker's earlier call (see docs/briefs/mission_bay_block_inventory.csv row P10, dated 2026-09-19) that P10 was 'roadway infrastructure' not worth a record -- on review, P10 is specifically the roundabout's own landscaped center island (grass, trees), a real, already-built park feature distinct from the road pavement around it, consistent with how this tracker already records P11A (the roundabout's half-circle median) and P11 (its connector strip). The owner's green outline was extracted from their annotated photo via ORB keypoint matching (a homography to the sent map image, chained to a second homography to a freshly-fetched satellite tile with a known exact lon/lat extent), avoiding manual pixel-guessing, then visually confirmed to sit cleanly on the real grass island at the center of the roundabout named 'Mission Bay Circle' on the source OCII land use diagram. join_approximate.py --strict flags roughly a quarter of this shape as inside the real street/curb buffer -- expected and correct, not mispositioning: a roundabout's center island is by definition ringed by its own circulating roadway, the same class of case already documented for P11A and Pier 70's 20th Street Plaza. street_clip_exempt set per that documented escape hatch.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- owner-guided satellite trace, not a surveyed footprint or GIS file from the project team. street_clip_exempt=true: this is a real roundabout center island, inherently ringed by the circulating roadway in DataSF's curb data -- clipping it against the generic street buffer would cut real, visible parts of the island, not a mispositioning artifact.
properties.notes: Center island of the real 'Mission Bay Circle' roundabout at the south end of the Mission Bay Circle/Owens St area, matching plan label P10. Landscaped with grass and trees; the roundabout's own median (P11A) and connector strip (P11) are tracked separately.
